market_summary: London session shows strong index bullish expansion (US100 making new highs) alongside ongoing US Dollar strength pushing EURUSD and GBPUSD towards session lows. Gold (XAUUSD) consolidates above daily VWAP/EMA50 seeking upside continuation, while Bitcoin (BTCUSD) shows minor bearish delta divergence at key resistance.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4040.14 to VAH 4060.33) and above POC 4044.58. CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.36) with positive slope. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding above VWAP (4048.78) and EMA50 (4051.19), consolidating near S/R 4052.38 mid-ATR channel. Volume is average without RVOL spikes. Expecting a push towards VAH / Session High, but lacking explosive volume confirmation.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish price holding above VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL 1.11430 and POC 1.11658, trading near Session Low 1.11314. CVD is NEUTRAL (-2,024) but short-term slope is positive. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trending firmly below VWAP (1.11527) and EMA50 (1.11553), riding near the lower ATR band (1.11352). Volume shows recent spikes confirming downward momentum, though price is currently resting near support.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish price below VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL 1.33223 and POC 1.33468, pressing right against Session Low 1.33140 and lower ATR band 1.33137. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,317) with slight positive slope. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Trend is strongly bearish below VWAP (1.33337) and EMA50 (1.33372). Lows are being repeatedly tested, indicating strong selling pressure into support.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish price well below VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is breaking above VAH 28261.60 and Session High 28261.60, far above POC 28114.25. CVD is BULLISH (+9.03) with positive slope. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. Price is cleanly trading above ascending VWAP (28081.90) and EMA50 (28073.75), riding the upper ATR band (28267.12). Note US100 Dukascopy tick volume caveat (lacks yellow RVOL bars), but strong directional alignment and delta support a breakout buy.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish strong trend above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: breakout above VAH 28261.60 and Session High

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH 73808.59 and POC 73660.40, currently rejecting S/R 73975.30 just below Session High 74085.20. CVD is BEARISH (-0.03) showing a divergence against recent high prices. SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. While price remains above VWAP (73650.72) and EMA50 (73705.04), it is stalling mid-channel without RVOL confirmation. Diverging delta and key resistance proximity warrant holding.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish price above VWAP and EMA50
